title: Add continuity bridge narration prompt
description: Separate from custody mechanics: touches DM UX/model prompting. After a catch-up-to-head, offer a short in-fiction explanation for the character's changed state. Parent: eshyra-lupf.14.4; depends on eshyra-lupf.14.4.2.
acceptance_criteria:
- After catch-up-to-head, generate or request a short continuity explanation.
- Support at least: player-provided explanation; DM-generated explanation.
- Include enough context for the model: prior local revision, new revision summary if available, current scene/session state.
- For mid-scene/combat, show an explicit warning before proceeding.
- Do NOT require this for the core catch-up mechanics to work.
